derivation: a primitive root meaning properly, to burn, i.e. (by implication)
def: to be rabid (figuratively, insane); also (from the exhaustion of frenzy) to languish

occurrences.text: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
